headline: Nasdaq 100 sank 3.5% Friday on Intel and Amazon AI-spending fears; VIX jumped 13% into the reopen.
brief: The Nasdaq 100 fell about 3.5% on Friday to roughly 28,385, closing below Thursday's low after Intel's weak outlook and Amazon's miss sparked a chip-led selloff, while the 10-year yield eased about 4 bp to 4.94%. Tonight's Asia session has only second-tier data such as China's Caixin manufacturing PMI, so price follow-through from Friday's selloff is likely to dominate. Key risks this week are Apple and Palantir earnings, Tuesday's midterm elections and Friday's jobs report amid rising December hike odds.
